title: VerificationEvidence
description: A single piece of evidence from the VERIFY step. Each evidence item represents the result of one rule evaluation against the resource's live state.

source.description: The verification source that produced this evidence. 'grip.guard/registry' for AWS Guard Rules Registry, 'grip.guard' for local Guard rules, 'grip.security' for heuristic fallback evaluation.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the rule that was evaluated. For Guard registry rules, this is the rule name (e.g., S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED). For heuristic rules, this is a custom identifier.

ruleDescription.description: Human-readable description of the rule or the violation it detected.

propertyPath.description: The resource property path that was evaluated. For value-based violations, this is the full path to the non-compliant property. For absence-based violations, this is the name of the missing property.

actualValue.description: The current value of the evaluated property in the resource's live state. Set to 'NOT SET' when the property is absent from the resource.

expected.description: The expected constraint or remediation action. Describes what the property value should be to satisfy the rule.
examples: Set BlockPublicAcls to true in PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.

corroborated.description: Whether this evidence represents a confirmed violation. true = the rule identified a non-compliant property value (VIOLATED). false = the rule passed (VERIFIED).

severity.description: Severity level of the finding. INFORMATIONAL is used for rules that passed.

relatedRuleIds.description: Rule IDs that were deduplicated into this evidence item. Present when multiple rules flagged the same property path and were consolidated into a single finding.
